# vastdata_vms_certificate (Resource)

Manages the **VMS** (web UI / API) TLS certificate.

Uses `PATCH /vms/{id}/set_certificate/` (`ssl_certificate`, `ssl_keyfile`). Destroy is a no-op: removing this resource does not reset the VMS certificate.

This resource is not importable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_vms_certificate" "vms" {
  vms_id      = 1
  certificate = file("path/to/tls.crt")
  private_key = file("path/to/tls.key")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PEM-encoded certificate (leaf plus optional chain). Write-only: never stored in Terraform state.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PEM-encoded private key. Write-only: never stored in Terraform state.
- `vms_id` (Number) ID of the VMS object (typically 1).

### Read-Only

- `certificate_md5` (String) MD5 of the leaf certificate DER (lowercase hex). Computed from certificate at plan time so a new certificate is applied automatically. Not settable.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the leaf certificate DER, lowercase hex.
- `not_after` (String) Not-after (expiry) of the leaf certificate, RFC3339 UTC.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the leaf certificate.
